game.q: the whole city turns. God spares it. how’s jonah?
opts: the city throws him a parade
so angry he asks to die
he books a nineveh city tour

wrong.parade: no parade. and he wasn’t in the mood.
wrong.tour: he never wanted to be there at all.

game.right: YES. furious. he knew God was gracious and merciful. that’s why he ran.

end.line: he ran the other way. God came back to the same runaway, a second time.
end.l2: God called the same runaway again.

cliff.s2: written in the ruins of a city.

share: god called. jonah ran. god called again. the story on infinite hill
